prerequisites.label: Skill 07 - KIE Setup
prerequisites.satisfy: Complete Skill 07 (kie-setup) first: it establishes the KIE account and credential this adapter uses.

prerequisites.label: Python 3 (standard library only)
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Python 3 (macOS: brew install python3; Debian or Ubuntu: apt install python3). The adapter uses only the standard library and needs no pip packages.

prerequisites.label: KIE API Key (presence only)
prerequisites.satisfy: KIE_API_KEY must be SET in ~/.openclaw/secrets/.env (Mac) or /data/.openclaw/secrets/.env (VPS), chmod 600. Check presence only and never print the value. If absent, ask the operator to provision it; do not mint a new key.
